votes.reason: Accepts complete recorded-input replay, explicit rejection/coverage and effect isolation. Semantics-preserving sanitation and native deadline separation resolve the paired reviewer's vacuity/model-derived-input concerns.
Proof-safe reclamation preserves Unknown, cleanup and replay floors. Both scenarios exercise authority safety rather than treating diagnostic rotation or persistent sharing as reclamation evidence.

Coherent recovery validation and interruption faults refine existing durable mechanisms. The scenarios correctly preserve uncertainty and original clocks instead of treating a checkpoint as action completion.

Accept as conditional cache correctness and measured-adoption contract. The unchanged-input performance scenario is an adoption qualification against frozen workloads, not a universal claim that caching improves every workload.

Declared abstraction, partial observation and stuttering preserve the distinction between bounded conformance and proof. State, ordered commands and resource comparisons catch equal-final-state regressions.

The typed-boundary requirement is sound, but Foreign input requires a correlated refusal even for malformed or foreign payloads that cannot establish authenticated correlation. This contradicts the uncertainty discipline in 011 and may fabricate terminal Refused.
requiredChanges: Replace Foreign input THEN with: no admitted event or mutation is produced; a bounded rejection diagnostic is retained. A correlated terminal Refused is retained only when authenticated exact native refusal or a validated unsent certificate proves it.

Protocol-specific reachability avoids importing static session-type claims or equating window Committed with preview Released. Producer-refusal/final-ack controls retain actor provenance and drainage obligations.

Admission and transfer are included in accounting; cancellation and release intent cannot discharge charge. The held-reader and pre-adoption-refusal scenarios preserve distinct producer/consumer closure.
Separates logical order, epochs and native monotonic time. Late receipts reconcile knowledge without timely-success claims, deadline renewal or mutation replay.

Validated outcome classes permit generic wording for unknown refusal reasons without manufacturing refusal from an unknown schema. The lost receipt and unrelated late receipt scenarios retain exact uncertainty.

One semantic announcement owner and native AT-active delivery are appropriate, but ERR-02-02 rejects all foreign-epoch updates without distinguishing unauthenticated foreign input from authenticated historical old-epoch receipts needed to settle retained Unknown after replacement.
requiredChanges: Replace ERR-02-02 foreign-epoch clause with: unauthenticated, unrelated or invalid foreign-binding receipts cause no announcement; authenticated exact historical receipts may reconcile retained Unknown through the declared native recovery path without granting a new epoch authority or changing its deadline.

votes.reason: Allowlisted bounded diagnostics remain observational and cannot consume authority/cleanup guarantees. Sensitive-canary and saturation cases test privacy and decision equivalence; no ring buffer or export mechanism is mandated.
Separates recovered availability from historical uncertainty and forbids geometry-only settlement. Storage-full, replacement-incarnation and original-deadline guards retain native recovery safety.

Defer the optional export feature pending explicit product selection and frozen assembly/retention/privacy budget decisions. Its no-upload and truthful-partial-artifact guardrails are sound; it must not block mandatory release.

Focus identity and press-time incarnation/lease validation are observable contracts rather than a DOM prescription. Retired-position reuse and unrelated publication scenarios preserve exact action targets.
Native semantic coherence and inert images refine existing accessibility obligations. The announcement scenario composes with 012 rather than claiming semantic properties alone prove AT delivery.
Composition generation and current field identity constrain committed text; consumed Enter cannot also launch. The delayed retired-field commit supplies a meaningful negative case.

Readability and reachability remain governed by measured frozen policy, not screenshots or tokens alone. Hotplug fallback and constrained reflow scenarios preserve native identity and keyboard usability.
Unavailable/unresolved guidance retains independent controls and safe context without automatic replay. Refusal does not imply restored state and keyboard recovery remains reachable.
Submission, presentation and retirement have separate identity-matched evidence. Image load/frameSwapped and stale-output receipts cannot prove replacement-transaction completion.
Only explicitly replaceable observations coalesce; effects and cleanup retain ordered reserved capacity. Late producer completion after close does not create demand or justify early allocation.

Native last-presented geometry and approved reduced-motion profile retain operation semantics. Queued-but-unpresented reversal and live preference change preserve original deadlines and retirement boundaries.
Same-machine budgets and minimally observed runs qualify actual presentation/resource spans with missing stages disclosed. This adds no paper-derived timing thresholds and preserves missed samples.

Separates proof identity from delivery continuity and permits known-safe idempotent Ack retry. Cross-entry proof interleaving and lost-Ack scenario correctly avoid false gaps or repeated physical cleanup.

Over-budget route rejection is conditional on actual measurement. Qualified alternatives/unavailable disclosure do not erase mandatory native source-stop/family evidence; no async implementation is imposed.

Bounded latest-content demand remains authorization-scoped and waits for eligible capacity. Genuine fresh request timing cannot renew the first capture deadline; close/lock/source replacement cancels follow-up admission.
Explicitly separates live source from old captured pixels, honoring frozen historical/live/unavailable policy. Revocation remains native and cannot leave eligible revoked pixels.
Native keyboard scope remains bounded and lock-inert with prior eligible identity retained. No new default shortcut, permanent exclusive mode or MRU override is introduced.

Supported-disabled state remains visible and non-dispatchable under a chosen per-surface navigation policy. All-disabled dismissal and focus-retirement scenarios avoid both forced focusability and traps.

philosophy.reason: All ten principles guide concrete decisions about exact targets, one policy controller, native physical evidence, uncertainty, continuity, native accessibility, ownership/recovery, customization contracts, measured bounded resources and evidence-level release closure. The text is technically honest about pending capabilities and distinguishes editorial name preference from technical acceptance. This is only my vote, not agreement by the other reviewers.

disagreements.issue: A malformed or foreign payload cannot itself prove a correlated terminal refusal. Require a rejection diagnostic unless exact authenticated evidence permits terminal disposition.
Reject untrusted foreign epoch input, but do not prohibit authenticated exact historical receipts from reconciling durable Unknown after frontend replacement.
Sound conditional contract, deferred pending explicit product selection and budget/policy evidence; not mandatory release expansion.
